question: Who among the following was conferred a Doctorate by the Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya in 1981?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra was conferred a Doctorate by the Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya in 1981.**
 
• He was a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer, known for **his contribution to the Odissi dance form.**
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj, another famous Indian classical dancer, has been conferred with several awards and honors but not a Doctorate by the **Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya in 1981.**
 
• M. R Krishnamurthy is not a well-known name in the field of Indian classical dance and hence is an unlikely option for the correct answer.
 
• Amala Akkineni, an Indian film actress, has no known association with the** Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya or Indian classical dance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Pandit Birju Maharaj** has been conferred with the** Padma Vibhushan, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and Kalidas Samman,** among others, for his contribution to the field of Indian classical dance.
 
• ** M. R Krishnamurthy i**s a well-known Indian classical vocalist and has been conferred with the Padma Shri and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• Amala Akkineni is a trained Bharatanatyam dancer and has performed in a few dance productions but is primarily known for her work in Indian cinema.
